name: Holder binding (key from secret)

request.need: PR-HLD / ADR-001 S4: the presenter is the subject, not a party holding a copy

statement: A verifier learns that the presenting key is derived from the same secret the credentials were issued to, without learning the secret or any long-term key.

relation.clause: pk_presentation = PRF(secret, context) and the credential commitment opens to the same secret

doesNotEstablish: absence of coercion or account sharing
compatibility with non-exportable keys or arbitrary credential key formats; the selected profile must bind the actual authenticated holder key to the available witness

options.construction: L_PRF Schnorr proof of PRF-key ownership (paper §9.1)

issuance: issuer binds the credential to a commitment to the holder secret (pk_U ‖ com_att signed — paper §2.4)

history.evidence: zkp-tf #18 (talltree 08-26 / Scott 08-27): seed set for the board

formal.system: Lean 4.33.1, core library only (no Mathlib); axiom footprint within propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound — no sorry, no added axiom
formal.location: formal/Formal/Gadgets/P004HolderBinding.lean in the evidence repository (uncommitted at this revision)
formal.reproduce: sh formal/scripts/check-axioms.sh — builds, prints each theorem's axiom footprint, fails on sorry or a non-standard axiom
formal.statement: Formal.Gadgets.HolderRel — pk = PRF(s, context) for an s the credential commitment opens to

theorems.name: key_from_credential_secret
theorems.proves: every opening of the credential's commitment gives the same presentation key: the key is derived from the secret the credential was issued to

theorems.name: unbound_key_unsound
theorems.proves: the commitment clause is necessary: without it a key from any secret passes

hypotheses.name: H-com
hypotheses.carries: the credential commitment is binding (modelled as injective in (secret, randomness))

formal.scope: derivation from the credential secret; non-transfer, coercion and sharing (does-not-establish 1, 2) are out of scope by construction — the relation reads a secret and names no party

revisions.note: formal model built (Lean, gadget library): the clause as a definition, its soundness, the counter-deployments that show which hypotheses are necessary, and the negative space classified; no state change
